cnTitle: 紫微斗数禄存星：守财积蓄的财库星，它和化禄不是一回事
enTitle: Lu Cun in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Savings Star Is Not the Same as Hua Lu
enDesc: Lu Cun is set by the birth-year stem, yin earth, governing steady accumulation, retained wealth and existing blessing—the stock. Hua Lu is flowing opportunity and gain—the flow. One keeps, one brings; they read differently.
cnDesc: 禄存由生年天干取、属阴土，主稳定积累、守财与现成福气，是「存量」；化禄是流动的机会与机缘，是「增量」，一个守一个来，读法完全不同。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天马星：动中求财，闲不住的变动之星
enTitle: Tian Ma in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Movement Star That Seeks Wealth Through Motion
enDesc: Tian Ma is set by the birth-year branch and lands only in the four horse palaces (Yin/Shen/Si/Hai), governing travel, movement, action and change. Neutral itself, with auspicious stars it earns through motion; with malefics it is restless toil—the company decides.
cnDesc: 天马由生年地支取、只落寅申巳亥四马地，主奔波、迁动、行动力与变化，本身中性，吉则动中生财、越跑越旺，凶则奔波劳碌、变动不安，关键看它和谁同宫。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数禄马交驰：为什么有的人越往外跑越有钱
enTitle: Lu-Ma Galloping in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Some People Get Richer the More They Move
enDesc: When Lu Cun (or Hua Lu) and Tian Ma share, oppose or trine, it is Lu-Ma galloping: wealth through motion and faraway gain. Money is fluid, earned through travel, secondment and cross-region trade, yet it still requires personal effort—a self-power pattern.
cnDesc: 禄存（或化禄）与天马同宫、对拱或三方会照叫禄马交驰，主动中生财、发异乡财，财是流动的，越在奔波、外派、跨区域贸易中越能得财，但仍需本人奔走、属自力格局。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数孤辰寡宿：形孤和心孤，晚婚与精神独立怎么读
enTitle: Gu Chen and Gua Su in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Outer Solitude, Inner Solitude, Late Marriage and Independence
enDesc: Gu Chen is yang fire—outer solitude, independence and wandering caused by environment; Gua Su is yin fire—inner solitude, reserve and being hard to reach. In Spouse/Happiness they often mean late marriage or emotional distance, but not destined loneliness; they can convert to independent depth.
cnDesc: 孤辰属阳火主外在环境造成的形孤、独立与漂泊，寡宿属阴火主内在精神上的心孤、寡合与难被走进，两星入夫妻福德多主晚婚或精神疏离，但并非注定孤独，反能转为独立深度。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数华盖星：艺术玄学天赋，和那份天生的清高
enTitle: Hua Gai in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Artistic and Metaphysical Gift, and a Natural Nobility of Spirit
enDesc: Hua Gai governs noble detachment, insight, art, religion and philosophy, and mastery of a specialized craft. In Life it gives intelligence, distinctive taste and spiritual interests, but also reserve and aloofness; well used it is master-level depth, misused it is detachment from reality.
cnDesc: 华盖主孤高、悟性、艺术、宗教哲学与专精之才，入命者聪明有独特审美、喜欢精神性事物，也容易不合群、自命清高，用得好是深耕一门的大师潜质，用偏则是脱离现实。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天刑星：法律、自律、刀光与医药缘
enTitle: Tian Xing in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Law, Self-Discipline, Blade Energy and an Affinity for Medicine
enDesc: Tian Xing governs law and discipline, blade energy (surgery, metal injury) and an affinity for medicine and metaphysics. In Life it gives strong principles and self-discipline, suiting law, enforcement and medicine; with malefics/Ji it means disputes, surgery or hard clashes—best resolved through expertise and rules.
cnDesc: 天刑主法律刑克、纪律、刀光（手术金属伤）与医药玄学缘分，入命者原则性强、能自律、适合法律军警医疗等行业，逢煞忌主官非、手术或硬碰硬的摩擦，宜以专业和规则化解。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数龙池凤阁：才艺、审美与专业形象的一对小吉星
enTitle: Long Chi and Feng Ge in Zi Wei Dou Shu: A Pair of Small Stars for Talent, Taste and Professional Image
enDesc: Long Chi and Feng Ge are a pair of assistant stars for talent, taste, fine craftsmanship and image. Long Chi leans to inner skill and quickness, Feng Ge to outward bearing and taste; meeting a major star they add polish and presence—gentle, icing-on-the-cake rather than rescue.
cnDesc: 龙池凤阁是一对主才艺、审美、精巧手艺与外在形象的辅星，龙池偏内在技艺与聪敏，凤阁偏外在风度与品味，同会主星能给专业和气质加分，力量温和，属锦上添花而非雪中送炭。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天哭天虚：情绪暗耗和空虚感从哪来、怎么补
enTitle: Tian Ku and Tian Xu in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Where Hidden Emotional Drain and Emptiness Come From and How to Fill Them
enDesc: Tian Ku governs low mood, sorrow and emotional drain; Tian Xu emptiness, unreality and weak confidence. Neither is strong alone, but each amplifies uncertainty in its palace, most visible with malefics/Ji or in Happiness; the fix is stable inner support and real results.
cnDesc: 天哭主低落、忧伤与情绪性消耗，天虚主空虚、不实与底气不足，两星本身力量不强，却会放大所在宫的不确定感，逢煞忌或在福德时最明显，解法是建立稳定的内在支撑和现实成果。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数兄弟宫：不只看手足，还看同辈朋友与事业合伙人
enTitle: The Siblings Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Siblings, Peers and Business Partners
enDesc: The Siblings palace reads sibling bonds and, more broadly, all peer relations: close friends, classmates, colleagues, partners and industry peers. Auspicious stars/transformations mean helpful peers and smooth partnership; malefics/Ji mean thin bonds, profit disputes or partnership conflict—key to judging whether to partner and rely on peers.
cnDesc: 兄弟宫看手足缘分，更看一切「平辈关系」：亲密朋友、同学同事、合伙人与同行。主星吉化主平辈有助、合伙顺遂，煞忌主缘浅、争利或合伙纠纷，是判断能不能合伙、靠不靠同辈的关键宫位。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数夫妻宫深度：配偶特质之外，更是你在亲密关系里的模式
enTitle: The Spouse Palace in Depth: Beyond the Partner's Traits, Your Own Pattern in Intimacy
enDesc: The Spouse palace shows the partner's character, appearance and the relationship, while mirroring your own needs, interactions and lessons in intimacy. Strong/auspicious means smooth; malefics/Ji do not mean no love but a relationship needing work; the opposite Career palace governs how love and career trade energy.
cnDesc: 夫妻宫既看配偶的性格外形与关系状态，也照见你自己在亲密关系中的需求、互动和课题。庙旺吉化主顺遂，煞忌不等于没感情，而是相处多磨、需要经营，对宫官禄还决定感情与事业的能量消长。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数奴仆宫（交友宫）：朋友、下属与你的圈层人脉
enTitle: The Friends/Subordinates Palace: Friends, Staff and the Network Around You
enDesc: The Friends/Subordinates palace reads friends, staff, coworkers and all self-to-crowd relations. Its stem flying Lu into Life means loyal friends and capable staff; flying Ji means bad company or being dragged down. Zi Wei here means capable but proud staff; with malefics, help often turns to opposition later—key for hiring and choosing friends.
cnDesc: 奴仆宫（交友宫）看朋友、下属、工友与一切「我对众人」的关系。宫干化禄入命主朋友有情义、下属得力，化忌入命主遇人不淑、被拖累，紫微在此主下属有能但骄，见煞多先助后反，是用人和择友的重要参考。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数三大框架总论：机月同梁、杀破狼、府相朝垣，你属于哪一种
enTitle: Three Core Zi Wei Dou Shu Frameworks: Ji-Yue-Tong-Liang, Sha-Po-Lang and Fu-Xiang—Which One Are You
enDesc: The major stars across your Life trine and Travel necessarily fall into one of three frameworks: Ji-Yue-Tong-Liang (stable builder), Sha-Po-Lang (pioneering changer), or Fu-Xiang (manager-coordinator). None is superior; only fitting tracks differ. Setting the framework before details is the first reading step.
cnDesc: 命宫三方四正（命财官迁）的主星组合，必然落入机月同梁、杀破狼、府相朝垣三大框架之一，分别对应稳定守成型、开创变动型、管理统筹型，三者无高下，只有适不适合的赛道，先定框架再看细节，是看盘第一步。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数机月同梁格：「作吏人」的稳定体制格与参谋路线
enTitle: Ji-Yue-Tong-Liang Pattern: The Stable Institutional Pattern and Advisory Route
enDesc: When Tian Ji, Tai Yin, Tian Tong and Tian Liang meet across the Life trine it forms Ji-Yue-Tong-Liang; the classics say it serves as an official—bright, steady, good at planning and coordination, best for public service, large firms, education and advisory staff. Chang/Qu improve it; malefics break the pattern and add波折 to stability.
cnDesc: 天机、太阴、天同、天梁在命宫三方四正交会成机月同梁格，古书说「机月同梁作吏人」，主聪慧稳健、善规划协调，最宜公职、大企业、文教与专业幕僚，逢文昌文曲更佳，见煞则破格、稳定中多波折。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数杀破狼格：天生开创者，动荡格局该怎么活
enTitle: Sha-Po-Lang Pattern: Born Pioneers and How to Live a Volatile Pattern
enDesc: Qi Sha, Po Jun and Tan Lang always meet in trine to form Sha-Po-Lang—bold, innovative, with big life swings. At best it opens new ground; at worst it is boom-bust. The keys are a competitive track, discipline to curb impulse, attacking in good cycles and storing strength in low ones.
cnDesc: 七杀、破军、贪狼永远在三方四正互相会照，构成杀破狼格，主刚劲敢闯、求新求变、人生起伏大，成则开创局面、败则大起大落，关键在选对竞争性赛道、用纪律收敛冲动、趁好运时进攻、低谷时蓄力。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数府相朝垣格：财库稳固、食禄千钟的管理格局
enTitle: Fu-Xiang Facing the Wall Pattern: A Stable Treasury and Management Destiny
enDesc: When Tian Fu and Tian Xiang meet across the Life trine without malefic break, it is Fu-Xiang facing the wall—steady, reliable, good at coordination, valuing security and dignity, suited to finance, administration, operations and leadership. Wealth accumulates through steady management and resource integration; auspicious transformations bring plenty, malefics reduce it and warn against over-conservatism.
cnDesc: 天府与天相在命宫三方四正照会、不见煞冲破为府相朝垣格，主稳重可靠、善统筹调度、重安全与体面，利财务、行政、运营、管理要职，财富靠稳健经营和资源整合累积，逢吉化富贵不小，见煞则减色、需防保守误机。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数日月反背：日月失辉就一定劳碌辛苦吗
enTitle: Sun-Moon Reversed: Does Dim Sun and Moon Always Mean Toil and Hardship
enDesc: When the Sun sits fallen in Xu/Hai and the Moon in Chen/Mao guarding Life, both dimmed, it is Sun-Moon reversed—the classics say toil, self-made success and day-and-night worry. It is not a fixed bad fate: with auspicious transformations or a technical profession people still succeed; the key is accepting a self-reliant, late-blooming, hard-working script.
cnDesc: 太阳在戌亥、太阴在辰卯等落陷位置守命、日月皆处失辉之地为日月反背，古书主劳碌、白手成家、昼夜操心，但它不是定死的差命，得吉化吉星或靠专业技术立身者照样有成，关键是理解「靠自己、晚成、多劳」的剧本并顺势安排。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数日月并明、月朗天门、日照雷门：日月庙旺的贵格
enTitle: Bright Sun-Moon Noble Patterns: Sun-Moon Radiant, Moon at Heaven's Gate, Sun at Thunder Gate
enDesc: Sun in Mao (sun at thunder gate), Moon in Hai (moon at heaven's gate), and Sun-Tian-Liang bright in Mao—major stars strong guarding Life—bring openness, visible talent, mentors and chances, favoring public service, academia and public expression. Opposite to reversed Sun-Moon, they still need auspicious support; malefics reduce the score.
cnDesc: 太阳在卯（日照雷门）、太阴在亥（月朗天门）、太阳天梁在卯并明（日月并明）等日月庙旺守命的组合，主光明磊落、才名外显、贵人与机遇较多，利公职、学术、公众表达，是与日月反背相对的一组贵格，但仍需吉曜会照、逢煞亦减分。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数石中隐玉格：巨门的隐藏才华，为什么越沉潜越发光
enTitle: Jade Hidden in Stone: Ju Men's Concealed Talent and Why Depth Makes It Shine
enDesc: When Ju Men guards Life in Zi/Wu, trining Lu Cun or Hua Lu without malefic break, it is jade hidden in stone. Ju Men governs speech and dispute and needs polishing; like uncut jade it endures early obscurity, then in middle/late years soars through eloquence, expertise, research or expression—a classic late-bloomer, accumulate-then-rise pattern.
cnDesc: 巨门在子午宫守命、三方会禄存或化禄且不见煞冲破为石中隐玉格，巨门本主口舌是非、需打磨，此格却如璞玉藏石，早年多磨砺、不被看见，中晚年靠口才、专业、研究或表达一飞冲天，是典型的大器晚成、厚积薄发格局。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数叠宫技法：本命、大限、流年三层叠在一起怎么读
enTitle: Palace Stacking in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Reading Life, Decade and Year Layers Together
enDesc: Palace stacking overlays Life, decade and year charts: Life is the base, the decade the ten-year environment, the year the trigger. When a palace is stacked across layers, that domain becomes the life focus then. Stacking sets the theme; flying/self-transformations set how it plays—the core technique from static chart to dynamic reading.
cnDesc: 叠宫是把本命盘、大限盘、流年盘的同名宫位叠加来看：本命是体、大限是十年环境、流年是当年触发，某宫被多层叠到，就代表那段时间该领域成为人生重心，叠宫定「主题」，飞化自化定「怎么演」，是从静态盘走向动态断事的核心技法。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数伏吟反吟：大限命宫叠本命、走到对宫意味着什么
enTitle: Fu Yin and Fan Yin: When the Decade Life Overlaps Natal Life or Sits Opposite
enDesc: When the decade Life reaches natal Life it is Fu Yin (same-palace overlap): the decade's focus returns to self, old lessons replay and success hinges on one's own character. Reaching the opposite palace is Fan Yin: external impact and reverse pull, change from environment and others. Reading these two special overlaps grasps the decade's inner rhythm.
cnDesc: 大限命宫走到本命命宫叫伏吟（同宫重叠），主这十年重心回到自己、旧课题重演、成败多由自身性格决定；走到本命命宫对宫叫反吟，主外在冲击与反向牵动、变动来自环境和他人，读懂这两种特殊叠宫能把握十年的内在节奏。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数来因宫是什么：钦天四化的总源头，一次讲清
enTitle: What Is the Lai Yin Palace: The Source of Qin-Tian Four Transformations, Explained
enDesc: Lai Yin (cause palace) is key in the Qin-Tian flying-transformations school: the palace holding the birth-year stem, the source from which birth-year Lu/Quan/Ke/Ji energy arises, determining which life theme the four transformations revolve around. The San-He school does not use it; it is an advanced flying view. Beginners need only grasp its role without confusing it with the natal palace system.
cnDesc: 来因宫是钦天四化（飞星）体系里的关键概念，指出生年天干所在的宫位，是生年四化能量的「来处」，决定这一辈子禄权科忌围绕哪个主题展开，三合派不排来因宫，它属于进阶飞化视角，入门者先理解其定位即可，不必和本命宫位体系混淆。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数太岁入卦法：看你和某个人关系的另一套方法
enTitle: Tai Sui Insertion Method: Another Way to Read Your Relationship With Someone
enDesc: Tai Sui insertion places the other person's birth-year stem (Tai Sui) into your own chart and reads where its four transformations land in your palaces, judging where two people connect, who gives more and where the bond sticks. Used for intimacy, family and partnership, it complements ordinary synastry, focusing on how the other's energy moves inside your chart.
cnDesc: 太岁入卦是把对方的生年天干（太岁）放进自己命盘，看其天干四化落入自己哪些宫，从而判断两个人在哪些领域有缘、谁付出多、关系卡点在哪，常用于亲密关系、亲子与合伙，是对常规合盘的补充，重在看「对方能量进入你命盘后的走向」。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数夹宫：两邻夹命的力量，吉夹和凶夹怎么分辨
enTitle: Flanking Palaces in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How the Two Neighbors Shape a Palace, Auspicious vs Hostile Flank
enDesc: Every palace is flanked by its two neighbors, whose stars support or suppress it: Zuo-You flank, Sun-Moon flank and wealth-shelter flank are auspicious and strengthen it; Yang-Tuo, Fire-Bell, Empty and punishment-Ji flanks are hostile and quietly drain it. Beyond the trine, flanking is the second force beginners most often miss.
cnDesc: 每个宫都被左右两邻宫「夹」，两邻星曜会对中间宫产生加持或压制：辅弼夹、日月夹、财荫夹为吉夹，增强该宫；羊陀夹、火铃夹、空劫夹、刑忌夹为凶夹，暗中消耗。三方四正之外，夹宫是最容易被新手忽略的第二股力量。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数会、照、冲、合：三方四正里的力量方向一次分清
enTitle: Meeting, Shining, Clashing and Combining: Sorting Out Force Directions in the Trine and Opposition
enDesc: Stars interact by sharing a palace (combine), trine meeting, opposite shining and opposite clashing: sharing is most intimate, trine is echoing support, opposition is head-on pull. Same-nature forces reinforce; opposite-nature forces tug. Sorting directions keeps meeting from being confused with sharing.
cnDesc: 星曜之间分同宫（合）、三方会（会）、对宫照（照）、对宫冲（冲）几种作用方式：同宫力量最贴身、三方为呼应支援、对宫为迎面牵引，吉凶相同时互相增强、吉凶相反时互相拉扯，分清力量方向，才不会把「会到」和「同宫」混为一谈。

cnTitle: 天府星坐命：财库之星的稳重、保守与藏锋
enTitle: Tian Fu Guarding Life: The Treasury Star's Steadiness, Conservatism and Hidden Edge
enDesc: Tian Fu is lord of the southern dipper, yang earth, qi of command, master of treasury and property. Guarding Life it makes one steady, reliable, good at accumulation and coordination, valuing security and dignity, with treasury-like包容 and leadership potential, but conservative, face-conscious and risk-averse. With Lu it enriches; with empty/drain stars the vault empties—the key is measured enterprise within steadiness.
cnDesc: 天府为南斗主、属阳土、化气为令、是财库与田宅之主，坐命者稳重可靠、善积累统筹、重安全感与体面，有「府库」般的包容和领导潜质，但偏保守、爱面子、怕冒险，得禄则富、逢空耗则库空，关键在学会在稳健中适度进取。

cnTitle: 廉贞星坐命：次桃花与囚星，一颗最复杂也最有企图心的主星
enTitle: Lian Zhen Guarding Life: The Secondary Peach and Prison Star—the Most Complex, Ambitious Major Star
enDesc: Lian Zhen is yin fire, qi of prison, the secondary peach: bright, versatile, fiercely ambitious, daring, social and aesthetic, yet emotionally volatile, competitive and prone to self-imprisoning obsession. With auspicious stars it is capable and charismatic; with malefics/Ji it leans impulsive, legal trouble or romantic entanglement—the star most shaped by later choices, red near cinnabar and black near ink.
cnDesc: 廉贞属阴火、化气为囚、为次桃花，主聪明多才、企图心强、敢闯敢拼、善交际与审美，也主情绪起伏、好胜和自我囚禁式的执念；遇吉则干练有成、魅力出众，遇煞忌则易冲动、官非或感情纠葛，是「近朱赤近墨黑」、最看后天选择的星。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数化忌一定不好吗：卡点、执着与你此生的修炼课题
enTitle: Is Hua Ji Always Bad in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Blockage, Attachment and Your Life Lesson
enDesc: Hua Ji is often read as disaster, but its essence is inward energy, blockage, attachment and focus—it marks where you care most, get stuck most, and may cultivate deepest expertise. It is not failure; with a strong major star and Lu/Quan it can succeed through focus. Guard against obsession and emotional drain.
cnDesc: 化忌常被当成大凶，其实它的本质是能量内收、阻塞、牵挂与执着，标出你在哪个领域最在意、最容易卡住、也最可能深耕成专家。化忌不等于失败，主星庙旺、有禄权配合时反而能靠专注成事，真正要防的是执念和情绪内耗。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数禄存、化禄、化权：三种「得财」到底差在哪
enTitle: Lu Cun, Hua Lu and Hua Quan in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Three Kinds of Financial Gain
enDesc: Lu Cun is stable stock and retained wealth (yin earth, fixed income, assets); Hua Lu is flowing opportunity and new income sources (encounter, chance, smooth gain); Hua Quan is seizing resources through control, action and status. All bring gain but respectively keep, attract and contest—only combined do they reveal one's earning pattern.
cnDesc: 禄存是稳定存量与守财（阴土、固定收入、资产），化禄是流动的机缘与新增财源（缘分、机会、顺境得财），化权是靠掌控力、行动力和地位去争取资源，三者都带「得」，性质却分别是守得住、进得来、争得到，组合起来才看得清一个人的赚钱模式。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数禄忌同宫、双化忌：能量对冲该怎么化解
enTitle: Lu-Ji Same Palace and Double Ji in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How to Resolve Energy Clash
enDesc: When a palace has both Hua Lu and Hua Ji (or Lu Cun with Hua Ji) it is Lu-Ji same-palace: gain contains loss, first get then worry. Two stacked Ji mean tangled, inward, back-and-forth energy there. Neither is a dead end; it signals chance and risk bound together—slow down, leave margin, and never bet the gain back at once.
cnDesc: 同一宫既化禄又化忌（或禄存与化忌同宫）叫禄忌同宫，主「得中有失、先得后忧」，两颗化忌叠加则主该宫能量纠结内收、反复折腾。它们不是死局，而是提示这个领域机会与风险绑在一起，关键在放慢、留余地、别把赚到的一次押回去。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数大限命宫怎么找、十年主轴怎么定
enTitle: How to Find the Decade Life Palace and Set a Ten-Year Theme in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: The decade starts at an age set by the Life palace's five-element phase, advancing clockwise for yang-male/yin-female and counterclockwise otherwise, ten years per palace; the palace reached is the decade Life palace. To set the ten-year theme, treat it as a new taiji, re-lay the twelve palaces, and read its major star, transformations and trine to judge the decade's theme, chances and lessons.
cnDesc: 大限（大运）以命宫五行局定起运岁数、按阳男阴女顺行、阴男阳女逆行，每宫十年，走到的那个宫就是这十年的「大限命宫」。定十年主轴的方法是：以大限命宫为新太极重排十二宫，看其主星、四化与三方四正，判断这十年的主题、机会与功课。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数流年怎么看吉凶：流年十二宫重排后的完整读法
enTitle: How to Read a Year's Fortune in Zi Wei Dou Shu: The Full Method After Re-laying the Year Twelve Palaces
enDesc: The year Life palace is set by that year's branch, then its twelve palaces re-laid as a taiji stacked over natal and decade. Reading a year needs three layers: the decade gives ten-year background, the year sets events; the year Life star and year transformations (where Lu/Quan/Ke/Ji fly) set that year's gains and timing, with months pinning the period.
cnDesc: 流年以当年地支定流年命宫，再以它为太极重排流年十二宫，叠在本命和大限之上。看一年吉凶要三层合参：大限给十年背景、流年定当年事件，流年命宫主星与流年四化（禄权科忌飞入哪宫）定这一年的得失与应期，再用流月落到具体时段。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数换大限的交接年，为什么最容易动荡
enTitle: Why Decade Transition Years Are the Most Turbulent in Zi Wei Dou Shu
enDesc: A year or two around a decade boundary, the old ten-year energy closes as the new opens, with both sets of decade transformations and focus acting at once—job change, moving, breakup, transformation and identity shifts are common. This is not bad luck but the normal shake of a gear-change; reading the transition structure early lets you plan and cross smoothly.
cnDesc: 两个大限交界前后一两年，旧十年的能量在收、新十年的能量在起，两套大限四化与重心同时作用，常见换工作、搬家、分手、转型、身份转变等大变动，这不是运气差，而是「换挡期」的正常震荡，提前看懂交接结构就能主动布局、平稳过渡。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数怎么看适不适合考公、走体制内路线
enTitle: How Zi Wei Dou Shu Shows Whether You Suit Civil Service and an Institutional Career
enDesc: For civil-service fit, focus on Career, Life and Travel: stable galaxies like Ji-Yue-Tong-Liang, Tian Fu/Tian Xiang and Sun/Tian Liang suit best; Chang/Qu/Hua Ke and Kui/Yue favor exams and mentors. Add the Parents palace (documents and scholarly repute) and the decade/year scholarly luck—multiple palaces auspicious together is the real signal of success.
cnDesc: 看考公与体制内发展，核心看官禄宫、命宫与迁移，机月同梁、天府天相、太阳天梁等稳定星系最适配，逢文昌文曲化科、天魁天钺利考试与贵人，再看父母宫（文书功名）与大限流年科甲运，多宫同吉才是真正「上岸」的信号。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数怎么看考试运和学业：命宫、官禄、父母宫与昌曲化科
enTitle: How Zi Wei Dou Shu Reads Exam and Study Luck: Life, Career, Parents Palaces with Chang-Qu and Hua Ke
enDesc: For study and exams, Life sets learning quality, Career (study as the body of career) sets effort direction, Parents as documents/repute palace shows diploma and examiner rapport, then Chang/Qu, Hua Ke and Kui/Yue scholarly stars, and finally decade/year for which exam has the best chance—a full chain of quality, effort, repute and timing.
cnDesc: 看学业考试以命宫定学习素质、官禄宫（学业为事业之体）定用功方向、父母宫为文书功名宫看文凭与考官缘，再看文昌文曲、化科、天魁天钺等科名星，最后用大限流年判断哪次考试最有机会，是一套「素质—用功—功名—时机」的完整链条。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数怎么看适不适合创业：杀破狼、官禄财帛与大限时机
enTitle: How Zi Wei Dou Shu Judges Entrepreneurship Fit: Sha-Po-Lang, Career/Wealth Palaces and Decade Timing
enDesc: Entrepreneurship fit depends on Life's pioneering resilience (Sha-Po-Lang, Zi Wei/Wu Qu/Tan Lang lean pioneering), whether Career suits independence over employment, whether Wealth/Property hold a fund-receiving vault, and whether Travel favors outward expansion. Crucially, whether the decade reaches a launch phase: natal fit plus decade activation is the window to act.
cnDesc: 创业适配看命宫有没有开创承受力（杀破狼、紫微武曲贪狼等偏开创）、官禄宫是否适合自立而非受雇、财帛与田宅有没有承接资金的库、迁移是否利向外开拓，更关键的是大限是否走到「可创业」的发动期，原盘适配＋大限引动，才是出手窗口。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数跳槽时机怎么看：官禄、迁移与大限流年的信号
enTitle: How to Read Job-Change Timing in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Signals from Career, Travel and Decade/Year
enDesc: Job change reads Career (the work itself), Travel (outward chance and movement), and Life/Happiness (inner urge). When Career or Travel is activated by Lu/Quan and the decade/year enters a movement structure it is a good window; moving amid Career Ji or malefic Travel is worse. The core is separating should-leave from want-to-escape and moving when energy rises.
cnDesc: 跳槽看官禄宫（工作本身）、迁移宫（向外的机会与变动）、命宫与福德（内心想不想动），官禄或迁移被化禄化权引动、且大限流年走到变动结构时是好窗口；官禄化忌、迁移逢煞时动反而更差，核心是分清「该跳」和「想逃」，并选在能量向上时动。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数破财信号与守财：财帛化忌、空劫怎么提前防
enTitle: Loss Signals and Wealth Defense in Zi Wei Dou Shu: How to Prepare for Wealth-Palace Ji and Empty Stars
enDesc: Loss risk reads Wealth-Palace Ji, Di Kong/Di Jie/Da Hao flanking or entering wealth, and an unstable Property vault, plus the decade/year activation timing. These signals are not destined loss but flag a phase of fragile cash flow, impulsive investment or being dragged down; lowering leverage early, keeping reserves and avoiding guarantees/high risk converts loss tendency into a close call.
cnDesc: 破财风险看财帛宫化忌、地空地劫大耗夹财或入财、田宅库位不稳，再叠加大限流年的引动时点。这些信号不等于注定破财，而是提示某阶段现金流脆弱、易冲动投资或被拖累，提前减杠杆、留备用金、避开担保高风险，就能把「破财倾向」化解成「有惊无险」。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数空宫是不是命差？借对宫反成大器的真相
enTitle: Is an Empty Palace Bad Fate in Zi Wei Dou Shu? The Truth That Borrowing the Opposite Can Make One Exceptional
enDesc: An empty palace has none of the fourteen major stars, only assistants and minor stars, so its own force is weaker and more influenced by environment—but it is never bad fate. It borrows the opposite palace's major star and reads both neighbors; borrowed well, free of fixed star nature, it is highly malleable, and many high achievers have an empty Life or key palace.
cnDesc: 空宫指本宫没有十四主星坐守，只有辅煞杂曜，主本宫力量偏弱、易受环境影响，但绝非命差：空宫要借对宫主星安星、再看两邻夹宫，借得好反而没有固定星性束缚、可塑性极强，很多成就者命宫或关键宫反而是空宫。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数双主星同宫怎么看：两颗主星到底谁听谁的
enTitle: Two Major Stars in One Palace in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Which One Leads
enDesc: A palace with two major stars (e.g. Zi Wei-Tian Fu, Lian Zhen-Tan Lang, Tian Tong-Tian Liang) is a dual-star palace; reading is not either-or but assigning lead and support: the stronger/brilliant star, the one with Lu/Quan/Ke, or the one most relevant to the question leads while the other tints; then see whether the pair complements or tugs, with malefics and transformations fixing the final nature.
cnDesc: 一个宫同时有两颗主星（如紫微天府、廉贞贪狼、天同天梁）叫双主星同宫，读法不是二选一，而是分主从、看生克：以庙旺有力、化禄权科、更贴合所问领域的那颗为主，另一颗调色，再看两星是相生互补还是互相拉扯，结合煞曜四化定最终性质。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数命会越算越薄吗：算命的正确打开方式
enTitle: Does Frequent Zi Wei Dou Shu Reading Weaken Your Fate? The Right Way to Use a Reading
enDesc: Fate thinning with frequent reading is not a metaphysical fact but a psychological one: repeatedly reading, hearing only bad results and treating tendency as fixed outcome erodes action and raises anxiety. A chart gives tendency range × environment × choice; the right use is understanding tendency, planning well and keeping decisiveness in your own hands—not replacing action with reading.
cnDesc: 「命越算越薄」不是玄学事实，而是心理现象：反复算命、只挑坏结果听、把倾向当定数，会让人丧失行动力、越算越焦虑，命盘给出的是「倾向区间×环境×选择」，正确用法是了解倾向、做好规划、把决定权握在自己手里，而不是用算命替代行动。
